findings.description: The code does not check if the buffer provided to prot_queue_init is large enough to hold the data elements.
The code does not check if the buffer provided to prot_queue_init is NULL.
The prot_queue_capacity function is not thread-safe.
The code does not handle the case where pthread_mutex_init or pthread_cond_init fails.
The code does not handle the case where prot_queue_destroy is called multiple times on the same queue.
